parameters: \c[1]Isanter Palace, headquarters of the Western Army\c[0]
That predictable oaf, Terenor...\! like a child playing with a cannon, the man deserves not the power he wields.
It should be a simple matter to overcome an oaf.
Would that I could wish it true, Diana.\! Harold, what are we looking at?

Sixty-thousand men, against our own twenty-thousand, my lord.\! An unknown amount of gun and cannon divisions from the Imperial Army will be backing Terenor as well.\! Our 1st Heavy Cavalry has finally mobilized at Fort Findorian, giving us some breathing room.
And we have the Temple warriors on our side...
As long as we control the river, let the Eastern Army come.\! We will destroy bridge after bridge until their supplies run dry.
Make them starve for going on the offensive.\| Terenor might just be dull-witted enough for that to work...
You have learned nothing since the Succession War.
Who is this disrespectful child?!\! You will address this council properly!
\n[8], was it?\! This is the one who was key in recapturing Trucea.

The enemy has more men and material. You cannot hope to win a war of attrition.\! But their army is retreating and regrouping since their loss at Trucea.\! The time to strike is now while they are off balance. If not now, then never.\! If they were to lose Fort Eureeka, it would be a painful effort for them to continue offensive operations.
You can't expect me to just commit my soldiers to this...
Duke Lothair, we have reason to trust in \n[8]'s judgement.\! ...\| I will accept personal responsibility if \n[8]'s plan fails.
If this adventure is a failure, your "personal responsibility" will mean very little to us when the enemy has removed all of our heads.
...\| If we can shock Terenor with a dramatic move, he may lose his enthusiasm for war.\! This land does not need another generation lost.
\n[8], we will support you how we can. Donar be with us.
I can't guarantee anything.\! But a small chance is better than no chance.
I sincerely hope you know what you're doing, Diana...
I do not presume to know.\! All that matters is that I believe.
